background: Banco Santander is Spain's largest bank and one of the largest in the eurozone, run as a group of self-funded national subsidiaries across Spain, the UK, Brazil, Mexico, the US and elsewhere, with retail and commercial banking at its core.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is the weak side against EU and Nordic banks, with CET1 of 14.0% in the bottom quarter and leverage of 4.8% below the peer median, though CET1 has risen 1.0 points since 30 Jun 2025. Liquidity sits close to the middle, LCR of 147% just below the median and NSFR of 124% just above it. No rating action has been taken in the last 90 days.
